content: Bollaa Ittippetethaa
Hewaa diraw, taani Godaw oothiyaa diraw qashetteeddawe Xoossay hinttena xeeseedda xeessaw bessiyaa de7uwaa hintte de7anaadan, taani hinttena woossay.
Ubba wode hintte hintte huuphiyaa kawushshiyaawantta, ashikketuwaanne danddayanchchatuwaa gidite; ittuu ittuwaa maaddiyaawan hintte siiquwaa bessite.
Hinttena ittippe gathi qachchiyaa sarotethaan, Geeshsha Ayyaanay hinttenttoo immiya ittippetethaa naaganaw minnite.
Xoossay hinttena xeeseedda hidootay, hintte demmana giide naagi utteeddawe mexxi ittuwaa gidowaadan, itti asatethaynne itti Geeshsha Ayyaanay de7ee.
Itti Goday, itti ammanuunne itti xinqqatay de7ee.
Ubbaa Goday, ubbaa bagganna oothiyaawe, ubbaa giddon de7iyaawe, itti Xoossay, ubbaa Aawuu de7ee.
Shin Kiristtoosi immeedda imuwaadan, nuuni huuphiyan huuphiyan dumma imuwaa akkeeddo.
Hewaa diraw, Xoossaa Maxaafay,
yaage.
Yaatina, “Pude keseedda” giyaawe waagiyaawe? I koyiro duge wodhdheedda; hewe sa7aw hirkki wurssethasaa wodhdheedda giyaawaa.
Ha duge wodhdheeddawe bare huuphew A; he I ubbabaa kumanaadan, saluwaa ubbaappe dhoqqiyaasaa pude keseedda.

Asaw imotaa immeeddawe A; I ittuwaa ittuwaa Yesuusi kiitteeddawantta, haratuwaa timbbitiyaa odiyaawantta, qassi haratuwaa mishiraachchuwaa qaalaa odiyaawantta, qassikka haratuwaa woosa golliyaa kaalethiyaawanttanne tamaarissiyaawantta oothi suntheedda.
I hewaa geeshshatuu ubbay ammaniyaa asaa oosuwaa oothanaadaninne Kiristtoosa bollan keexettanaadan giigissanaw ootheedda.
Qassi nuuni ubbay Xoossaa Na7aa ammaninanne erina beettiyaa ittippetethaakko gakkana; nuuni Kiristtoosa polo dichchaa keenaa dicciide, donza asa gidanaadana.
Nuuni beetan yaanne haanne shocettiide, barenttu cimmiyaa hanotaan asaa balaa ogiyaa kaalethiyaa geniyaa asaa timirttiyaa carkkuwaa ubbaan sugettiidde, hawaappe sinthaw na7a gidanaw bessenna.
Shin nuuni siiqotethan tumuwaa haasayiidde, huuphe gidiyaa Kiristtoosakko ubbabaani diccanaw bessee.

Bollaa giddon de7iya dumma dumma shaakotay aani ittippe oyqetteeddino; qassi kumentha bollay barew imetteeddasaa ubbaan ittuu ittuwaanna gakeettiide, ittippe oyqqetti utteedda; he dumma dumma shaakotay oothanaw bessiyaawaa oothiyaa wode, kumentha bollay siiquwan dicceenne barena keexxee.
Kiristtoosan Beettiyaa Ooratha De7uwaa
Hewaa diraw, taani hawaa hinttenttoo Godaa sunthan odaynne markkattay. Hintte go77i bayinna qofaa qoppiyaa Ayihuda gidenna asatuwaadan de7oppite.
Unttunttu wozanay dhumaani de7ee; unttunttu ayinne erennawanttanne azazettenna diraw, Xoossay immiya de7uwaappe haakkeeddino.
Unttunttu matan yeella giyaawe baawa; unttunttu woshummaw kajjeelanaw barenttu huuphiyaa aathi immiino; qassi tunabaa ubbaa paci bayinnaan oothanaw loythi yorattiyaawantta.
Shin hintte Kiristtoosawaa hewaadan tamaaribeyikkita.
Aabaa tumu siseeddita; qassi tumatethaykka Yesuusan de7iyaawaa, aappe tamaareeddita.
Hintte kase de7iya de7uwaa aggite; qassi bare cimmiyaa amuwan dhayiyaa hintte eca asatethaa dhayissite.
Hintte wozanaynne qofay ubbanna ooraxxanaw bessee.
Tumu xillotethaaninne geeshshatethan Xoossaa leemisuwan medhetteedda ooratha asatethaa mayyite.
Simmi worddotoppite. Nuuni ubbay Kiristtoosa asatethan itti asaa gidiyaa diraw, asay ubbay bare ishaw tumuwaa haasayanaw bessee.
Hanqqettite; shin hintte hanqquwan nagaraa oothoppite. Hintte hanqquwan de7ishshin, away wulloppo.
Xalahew xoo77iyaa immoppite.
Wuu77iyaa uray hawaappe sinthaw wuu77oppo; shin hewaa aggiide, hiyyeesatuwaa maaddanaw, bare kushiyan lo77obaa oothiidde daaburo.
Hintte haasayay sisiyaawantta go77ana mala, koshshiyaawaadan menthethiyaa lo77o qaalay hintte doonaappe kesoppe attin, iita qaalay mulekka kesoppo.
Xoossay hinttena woziyaa gallassaw hintte attametti utteedda Xoossaa Geeshsha Ayyaanaa kayyoyoppite.
Ixxiyaa hanotaa, yiilluwaa, hanqquwaa, waasuwanne cashshaa ubbaa iitatethaa ubbanna hintteppe dhayissite.
Ittuu ittoo keekitenne qarettite; qassi Xoossay Kiristtoosa bagganna hinttenttoo atto geeddawaadan, hinttekka ittuu ittuwaa atto giite.
